ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
